answer: Resist sybils via delegated trust lineage. New identities start weightless; voting power arrives only through stake delegated from established agents, and each delegation locks the delegator's funds. Backers leave a trace like pigment: lineage is visible on-chain. Weight grows slowly across epochs, from a faint dawn to full standing, so farmed sybils never reach quorum in time. Delegation graphs are public: identities fed by one funding cluster form an artificial opal-like knot of edges, and reviewers slash the cluster. Attacker cost is linear per sybil; honest agents pay one registration.
